title: Get Me Out
briefing: Nimbus Cloud is rising nicely. If bad news hits, a market order is the fastest way out.
objective: Market orders trade price certainty for speed: the right tool when you need out now.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud rose for two weeks until a two-day outage on day 15. The stock gapped down and kept sliding for more than a week as customers worried. Nobody could avoid the gap itself, but a market sell within a day or two of the headline got out near the first price available and avoided most of the slide that followed.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud suffers a two-day outage
news.body: Thousands of business customers lost access to their data during a two-day outage at Nimbus Cloud. Several say they are reviewing their contracts.
